name: Alameda Free Library Teen Volunteers (Book Reviewers and Coding with LEGO)
what_you_do: Write teen book reviews (1 service hour each, one a month) or help younger kids with LEGO coding activities.
who_can_apply: Teen Book Reviewers: grades 7 to 12. Coding with LEGO: ages 12 to 17.
how_to_apply: LEGO program: email Fernanda Nunez at fnunez@alamedaca.gov. Book reviews: use the Teen Book Reviews page. Questions: refdesk@alamedaca.gov or 510-747-7777.
notes: Book reviews are limited to one a month. No coding experience needed for LEGO. See also Alameda Free Library Teen Advisory Group (TAG) for the advisory role, where teens suggest ideas for library events and projects.
